select count(publicid) from (Select Dt.ID													 As GWRowNumber
     , Dt.PublicID                                               As PubliciD
-- Dt.EventTimestamp
--Cl.updatetime
     , IsNull(Cl.PublicID						 , '-1')		 As Lkp_ClaimID
     , IsNull(Po.PublicID						 , '-1')		 As Lkp_PolicyID
	 , IsNull(Po.PolicyNumber					 , '-1')		 As Lkp_PolicyNumber
	 , IsNull(Po.CurrentPeriodID_Ext		     ,  -1 )	     As Lkp_PolicyRowNumber
	 , Po.PolicySuffix											 As Lkp_TermNumber
	 , Cast ( Cl.LossDate			 As DateTime)				 As Lkp_PolicyLossDate
	 , IsNull(Ex.PublicID						 , '-2')		 As Lkp_ExposureID
	 , IsNull(Ur.PublicID						 , '-1')		 As Lkp_UserID
	 , IsNull(Gr.PublicID						 , '-1')		 As Lkp_GroupID
	 , IsNull(Cast(Cl.LossDate       As Date	), '1900-01-01') As Lkp_LossDateID
	 , IsNull(Cast(Dt.EventTimestamp As Date	), '1900-01-01') As Lkp_FromDateID
	 , IsNull(Cast(Dt.EventTimestamp As DateTime), '1900-01-01') As FromDate
     , Case When Po.ProducerCode = '0000' Then '-1' Else IsNull(Left(Po.ProducerCode, CharIndex('-', Po.ProducerCode, 1) -1), '-1') End As Lkp_AgencyCode
	 , Dt.BeanVersion

	 /*for update Lossdate*/
     , CAST(cl.LossDate AS DATE) AS Lkp_LossDate

  From      cc_history         Dt
       Join cctl_historytype Tlht On Tlht.ID       = Dt.[Type]
  Left Join cc_claim           Cl On   Cl.ID       = Dt.ClaimID
  Left Join cc_policy          Po On   Cl.PolicyID = Po.ID
  Left Join cc_exposure        Ex On   Ex.ID       = Dt.ExposureID
  Left Join cc_user            Ur On   Ur.ID       = Dt.AssignedID_Ext
  Left Join cc_group           Gr On   Gr.ID       = Dt.AssignedGroupID_Ext
 Where Tlht.TypeCode          = 'Assignment'
   And Dt.MatterID            Is Null
   And Dt.TransactionSetID    Is Null
   And Dt.BulkInvoiceID       Is Null
   And Dt.ServiceRequestID    Is Null
   And Po.CurrentPeriodID_Ext Is Not Null
   /*And (
        Dt.EventTimestamp >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementalDays, Cast(GetDate() As Date))
	Or  Cl.UpdateTime     >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementalDays, Cast(GetDate() As Date))
	   )*/
) as main;

TARGET_QUERY: select count(publicid) from dbo.FactBOPPremiumTransaction Where GWRowNumber > 0;

SOURCE_QUERY:
Select COUNT(Publicid) from (Select Distinct
       T.ID																									   As GWRowNumber
	 , T.PublicID																							   As PublicID
	 , Coalesce(Ph.ID                , PP.ID                                                     )             As BranchID
     , Coalesce(Ph.PublicID			 , Pp.PublicID									, '-2'	     )             As PolicyNumberLkp
     , IsNull(uc.PublicID			 , '-2')																   As CompanyLkp
	 , IsNull(ProdCode.PublicID		 , '-2')																   As ProducerLkp
	 , IsNull(GaExt.PublicID		 , '-2')																   As AgencyLkp
	 , IsNull(Ac.PublicID			 , '-2')																   As AccountLkp
	 , Coalesce(Plc.PublicID		 , '-2')																   As RiskLocationLkp
	 , IsNull(Pl.PublicID			 , '-2')																   As LOBLkp
	 , IsNull(Pa.PublicID			 , '-2')																   As CoverageLkp
	 , IsNull(Pa.EffectiveDate		 , Pp.PeriodStart)														   As CoverageEffectiveDate
	 , Coalesce(Pb.PublicID			 , '-2')																   As BuildingLkp
	 , Coalesce(Pc.PublicID			 , '-2')															       As ClassificationLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert(Varchar   , Pp.PeriodStart			, 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')		       As PolicyEffectiveDateLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert(Varchar   , T.EFFectiveDate			, 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')			   As EffectiveDateLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert(Varchar   , T.ExpirationDate			, 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')		       As ExpirationDateLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert(Varchar   , T.DateWritten			, 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')			   As WrittEndateLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert(Varchar   , T.DatePosted             , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')			   As PostedDateLkp
	 , Case When T.DatePosted		   Is Not Null Then
	             Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.DatePosted   , 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.EffectiveDate     , 101) As DateTime)
                      Then Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.DatePosted   , 101) As DateTime)
                 Else      Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.EffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime) End
       Else '12/31/9999' End																				   As RecognizedDate
     , Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar, J.CloseDate              , 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, Pp.EditEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
            Then Cast(Convert(Varchar, J.CloseDate              , 101) As DateTime)
       Else      Cast(Convert(Varchar, Pp.EditEffectiveDate     , 101) As DateTime) End						   As DWPRecognizedDate
	 , LSju.TypeCode																					       As LocationState
	 , T.CededPremium
	 , T.SpoilageLimit_Ext
	 , T.SpoilageRate_Ext
	 , T.CommissionRate
	 , T.CededRiskAmount
	 , T.CedingRate
	 , T.CalcTimestamp
	 , T.DateWritten
	 , T.DatePosted
	 , Rp.PublicID																							   As ProgramPublicID
	 , Ra.PublicID																							   As AgreementPublicID
  From pcx_bp7cededpremiumtrans             T
  Left Join pcx_bp7cededpremiumhistory	    H On T.BP7CededPremiumHistory										=  H.ID
  Left Join pcx_bp7cededpremium			    E On T.BP7CededPremium												=  E.ID
  Left Join pc_RIProgram				   Rp On T.Program														= Rp.ID
  Left Join Pc_ReinsuranceAgreement		   Ra On T.Agreement													= Ra.ID
       Join pcx_bp7cost                    Pa On E.BP7Cost														= Pa.ID
	   Join pc_policyperiod                Pp On Pa.BranchID													= Pp.ID
 ----> Line Coverages, Exclusions And Conditions
  Left Join pcx_bp7linecov				   Cl On Pa.LineCoverage											    = Cl.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Cl.BranchID
		And ((Cl.EffectiveDate    Is Null)	  Or (Coalesce(Cast(Cl.EffectiveDate     As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Cl.ExpirationDate   Is Null)    Or (Cast(Cl.ExpirationDate		     As Date)				    > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pcx_bp7lineexcl				  Cle On Pa.LineExclusion_Ext											= cle.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Cle.BranchID
	    And ((cle.EffectiveDate   Is Null)	  Or (Coalesce(Cast(cle.EffectiveDate    As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((cle.ExpirationDate  Is Null)	  Or (Cast(cle.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pcx_bp7linecond				  Clc On Pa.LineCondition											    = CLc.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Clc.BranchID
		And ((CLc.EffectiveDate   Is Null)    Or (Coalesce(Cast(CLc.EffectiveDate    As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((CLc.ExpirationDate  Is Null)    Or (Cast(CLc.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
 ----> Classification Coverages, Exclusions And Conditions
  Left Join pcx_bp7Classificationcov       Cc On Pa.ClassificationCov										    = Cc.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Cc.BranchID
	    And ((Cc.EffectiveDate    Is Null)    Or (Coalesce(Cast(Cc.EffectiveDate     As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Cc.ExpirationDate   Is Null)    Or (Cast(Cc.ExpirationDate             As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pcx_bp7Classificationexcl     Cce On Pa.ClassificationExclusion_Ext								    = Cce.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Cce.BranchID
		And ((Cce.EffectiveDate   Is Null)	  Or (Coalesce(Cast(Cce.EffectiveDate    As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Cce.ExpirationDate  Is Null)	  Or (Cast(Cce.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pcx_bp7Classificationcond     Ccc On Pa.ClassificationCond_Ext									    = Ccc.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Ccc.BranchID
		And ((Ccc.EffectiveDate   Is Null)    Or (Coalesce(Cast(Ccc.EffectiveDate    As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Ccc.ExpirationDate  Is Null)    Or (Cast(Ccc.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
 ----> Building Coverages, Exclusions And Conditions
  Left Join pcx_bp7Buildingcov             Bc On Coalesce(Pa.BuildingCov, Pa.AssocCov, Pa.BldgCov)			    = Bc.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Bc.BranchID
	    And ((Bc.EffectiveDate    Is Null)	  Or (Coalesce(Cast(Bc.EffectiveDate	 As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((Bc.ExpirationDate   Is Null)    Or (Cast(Bc.ExpirationDate			 As Date)				    > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pcx_bp7Buildingexcl           Bce On Pa.BuildingExclusion_Ext									    = Bce.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Bce.BranchID
		And ((Bce.EffectiveDate   Is Null)    Or (Coalesce(Cast(Bce.EffectiveDate    As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((Bce.ExpirationDate  Is Null)	  Or (Cast(Bce.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pcx_bp7Buildingcond           Bcc On Pa.BuildingCond_Ext										    = Bcc.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Bcc.BranchID
	    And ((Bcc.EffectiveDate   Is Null)	  Or (Coalesce(Cast(Bcc.EffectiveDate    As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((Bcc.ExpirationDate  Is Null)	  Or (Cast(Bcc.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  ----> Location Coverages, Exclusions And conditions
  Left Join pcx_bp7locationcov             Lc On Pa.LocationCov												    = Lc.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Lc.BranchID
		And ((Lc.EffectiveDate    Is Null)	  Or (Coalesce(Cast(Lc.EffectiveDate     As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Lc.ExpirationDate   Is Null)	  Or (Cast(Lc.ExpirationDate             As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pcx_bp7locationexcl           Lce On Pa.ExclLocation_Ext										    = Lce.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Lce.BranchID
	    And ((Lce.EffectiveDate   Is Null)    Or (Coalesce(Cast(Lce.EffectiveDate    As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((Lce.ExpirationDate  Is Null)    Or (Cast(Lce.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pcx_bp7locationcond           Lcc On Pa.condLocation_Ext										    = Lcc.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Lcc.BranchID
	    And ((Lcc.EffectiveDate   Is Null)    Or (Coalesce(Cast(Lcc.EffectiveDate    As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((Lcc.ExpirationDate  Is Null)    Or (Cast(Lcc.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart))) --159
  ----> Building & Location
  Left Join pcx_bp7classification          Pc On Coalesce(Cc.Classification, Pa.AssociatedClassification, Pa.Classification, Pa.AssocClassification, Cce.Classification, Pa.ExclClassification_Ext, Pa.condclassification_Ext, Ccc.Classification) = Pc.FixedID  And Pa.BranchID = Pc.BranchID
	    And ((Pc.EffectiveDate    Is Null)    Or (Coalesce(Cast(Pc.EffectiveDate     As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((Pc.ExpirationDate   Is Null)    Or (Cast(Pc.ExpirationDate             As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pcx_bp7Building                Pb On Coalesce(Bc.Building, Pc.Building, Pa.AssociatedBuilding, Pa.Building, Pa.AssocBuilding, Bce.Building, Pa.ExclBuilding_Ext, Pa.CondBuilding_Ext, Bcc.Building									 ) = Pb.FixedID  And Pa.BranchID = Pb.BranchID
	    And ((Pb.EffectiveDate    Is Null)    Or (Coalesce(Cast(Pb.EffectiveDate     As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((Pb.ExpirationDate   Is Null)    Or (Cast(Pb.ExpirationDate             As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pcx_bp7location               Ppb On Coalesce(Lc.Location, Pb.Location, Lce.Location, Pa.ExclLocation_Ext , Pa.CondLocation_Ext, Lcc.Location																						 ) = Ppb.FixedID And Pa.BranchID = Ppb.BranchID
	    And ((Ppb.EffectiveDate   Is Null)    Or (Coalesce(Cast(Ppb.EffectiveDate    As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((Ppb.ExpirationDate  Is Null)    Or (Cast(Ppb.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_policylocation             Plc On Ppb.Location												    = Plc.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Plc.BranchID
	    And ((Plc.EffectiveDate   Is Null)    Or (Coalesce(Cast(Plc.EffectiveDate    As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((Plc.ExpirationDate  Is Null)    Or (Cast(Plc.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_etlclausepattern           Ecp On Ecp.PatternID = Coalesce(Cl.PatternCode, Lc.PatternCode, Bc.PatternCode, Cc.PatternCode, Cle.PatternCode, Cce.PatternCode, Bce.PatternCode, Lce.PatternCode, Clc.PatternCode, Ccc.PatternCode, Bcc.PatternCode, Lcc.PatternCode)
  Left Join pc_policyline                  Pl On Pa.Line													    = Pl.FixedID								And Pa.BranchID = Pl.BranchID
	    And ((Pl.EffectiveDate    Is Null)	  Or (Coalesce(Cast(Pl.EffectiveDate     As Date), Pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And ((Pl.ExpirationDate   Is Null)	  Or (Cast(Pl.ExpirationDate             As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_uwcompany                   Uc On Pp.uwcompany													= uc.ID
  Left Join pc_producercode          ProdCode On Pp.ProducerCodeOfRecordID										= ProdCode.ID
  Left Join pc_group                      Grp On ProdCode.Agency_Ext											= Grp.ID
  Left Join pcx_groupagency_ext         Gaext On Grp.GroupAgency_Ext											= GaExt.ID
  Left Join pc_policy                      Po On Pp.PolicyID													= Po.ID
  Left Join pc_account                     Ac On Po.AccountID													= Ac.ID
  Left Join pctl_jurisdiction            LSju On LSju.ID														= Pa.LocationState
  Left Join pc_job				            J On Pp.JobID														= J.ID
  Left Join pctl_job			          Jtl On J.Subtype														= Jtl.ID
  Left Join pc_job						   Jh On Jh.JobNumber													= (Case When H.CommentText  Is Not Null Then Substring(CommentText, 11,10) Else Null End)
  Left Join pc_policyperiod				   Ph On Jh.ID															= Ph.JobID And Ph.ModelDate Is Not Null
 Where 1 = 1
   And Pp.ModelDate Is Not Null
-- And ( t.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, ?, GetDate()))
-- And Pa.PublicID = 'pc:3324'

SOURCE_QUERY:

 select COUNT(Publicid) from (Select J.JobNumber		                         As SubmissionNumber
      , Jed.PublicID
      , Edr.PublicID	                         As ExtDataReferencePublicID
      , Jed.ID                                   As  GWRowNumber
      , Edr.ID                                   As ExtDataReferenceGWRowNumber

      , Edrt.TypeCode                            As  ExternalDataReferenceReportType
      , Jed.CreateTime                           As [JobExtDataCreateTime]
      , Jed.UpdateTime                           As [JobExtDataUpdateTime]
      , Concat(J.BeanVersion, Jed.BeanVersion, Edr.BeanVersion) As BeanVersion
   From pc_job								   J
   Join pcx_jobextdataref_ext				 Jed On Jed.Job                   =    J.ID
   Join pcx_externaldatareference_ext		 Edr On Jed.ExternalDataReference =  Edr.ID
   Left Join pctl_job						 Jlt On   J.Subtype				  =  Jlt.ID
   Left Join pctl_extdatareferencetypes_ext Edrt On Edr.ExtDataRefType		  = Edrt.ID
  Where 1 = 1
    --And (
	--       J.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementDays, Getdate())
     --Or  Jed.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementDays, Getdate())
     --Or  Edr.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementDays, Getdate())
       -- )
) as main;

--Declare @IncrementalDays Int = ?;
Select COUNT(Publicid) from (Select A.PublicID                                                  As PublicID
     , A.ID                                                        As GWRowNumber
, A.BeanVersion                                               As BeanVersion
     , A.CreateTime                                                As CreatedDate
     , A.TargetDate                                                As DueDate
, P.[Name]                                                    As [Priority]
, S.[Name]                                                    As ActivityStatus
, A.CloseDate                                                 As CompleteDate
, IsNull(A.CloseUserID         ,   -1)                        As ClosedByUserID
, A.[Subject]
, Case When A.ExternallyOwned = 0 Then 'N'
        When A.ExternallyOwned = 1 Then 'Y'
   Else Null End    As [External]
, Coalesce(Ce.[Name], Concat(Ce.FirstName, ' ', Ce.LastName)) As ExtOwner
, A.ExternalOwnerCCID
, IsNull(A.AssignedByUserID    ,   -1)                        As AssignedByUserID
, IsNull(A.AssignedUserID      ,   -1)                        As AssignedtoUserID
, IsNull(C.PublicID , '-1')                        As ClaimPublicID
, IsNull(E.PublicID     , '-1')                        As ExposurePublicID
, IsNull(Pl.CurrentPeriodID_Ext,   -1)                        As Lkp_PolicyRowNumber

,Case When IsNull(Ps.TypeCode, 'PC') != 'PC' Then PolicyNumber Else Null End As PolicyNumber --Used in DFT_Conv
,Case When IsNull(Ps.TypeCode, 'PC') != 'PC' Then Cast(Pl.EffectiveDate As DateTime) Else Null End As EffectiveDate --Used in DFT_Conv
, Case When IsNull(Ps.TypeCode, 'PC') = 'PC' Then 'N'
    Else 'Y' End As IsConv

-- into ##ClaimAct
  From      cc_activity     A
       Join cc_claim C  On  A.ClaimID    =  C.ID
  Left Join cctl_priority       P  On  A.[Priority]    =  P.ID
  Left Join cctl_activitystatus S  On  A.[Status]    =  S.ID
  Left Join cc_exposure         E  On  A.ExposureID    =  E.ID
  Left Join cc_claimcontact     Ec On  A.ExternalOwnerCCID = Ec.ID
  Left Join cc_contact          Ce On Ec.ContactID         = Ce.ID
  Left Join cc_policy           Pl On  C.PolicyID          = Pl.ID
  Left Join cctl_policysource   Ps On Pl.policysource      = Ps.ID
 Where 1 = 1
   And  --DFT1
   (  IsNull(Ps.TypeCode, 'PC' ) = 'PC'
      --And A.UpdateTime  >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementalDays, Cast(GetDate() As Date))
    )
Or --DFT_Conv
(   IsNull(Ps.TypeCode, 'PC' ) != 'PC'
       --And ( A.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementalDays, Cast(GetDate() As Date))
              --Or   C.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementalDays, Cast(GetDate() As Date))
        --)
)
) as main;

select COUNT(Publicid) from (Select Dt.PublicID
     , Dt.ID													 As GWRowNumber
	 , IsNull(Po.AccountNumber			         , '-1')		 As Lkp_AccountID
	 , IsNull(Po.PolicyNumber					 , '-1')		 As Lkp_PolicyNumber
	 , IsNull(Po.CurrentPeriodID_Ext			 , '-1')		 As Lkp_PolicyRowNumber
     , IsNull(Cl.PublicID						 , '-1')		 As Lkp_ClaimID
	 , IsNull(Ex.PublicID						 , '-2')		 As Lkp_ExposureID
	 , IsNull(Ur.PublicID						 , '-1')		 As Lkp_UserID
	 , IsNull(Ua.PublicID                        , '-1')         As Lkp_UserAssignedID
	 , IsNull(Gr.PublicID						 , '-1')		 As Lkp_GroupID
	 , IsNull(Cast(Dt.EventTimestamp As Date    ), '1900-01-01') As Lkp_EventTimeStampDateID
	 , IsNull(Cast(Dt.EventTimestamp As DateTime), '1900-01-01') As EventTimeStamp

	 , Case When CharIndex('-', Coalesce(Po.OfRecordProducerCode_Ext, Po.ProducerCode), 1) > 0
	             Then Coalesce(Po.OfRecordProducerCode_Ext, Po.ProducerCode)
		    Else IsNull(Coalesce(Po.OfRecordProducerCode_Ext, Po.ProducerCode) + '-XXX', '-1')
	   End                                                       As Lkp_ProducerCode
	 , Case When CharIndex('-', Coalesce(Po.OfRecordProducerCode_Ext, Po.ProducerCode),  1) > 0
	             Then IsNull(Left(Coalesce(Po.OfRecordProducerCode_Ext, Po.ProducerCode), CharIndex('-', Coalesce(Po.OfRecordProducerCode_Ext, Po.ProducerCode) ,1)-1),'-1')
	        Else IsNull(Coalesce(Po.OfRecordProducerCode_Ext, Po.ProducerCode), '-1')

With RiskLocation As
(
	 -- For CP Line level Coverages  we are using Primary Location as Risk Location fOr ISO Reporting fOr premium & Losses
     Select PP.ID							  As BranchID
		  , Pl.PublicID
	   From pc_policyperiod				  PP
	   Join pc_policylocation			  Pl  On PP.ID = Pl.BranchID
	   Join pc_EffectiveDatedfields		  Ef  On PP.ID = Ef.BranchID And Ef.PrimaryLocation = Pl.FixedID
        And ((Ef.EffectiveDate  Is Null)  Or (Coalesce(Ef.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) >= Coalesce(Pl.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart)))
        And ((Ef.ExpirationDate Is Null))
	  Where 1 = 1
	    And PP.ModelDate      Is Not Null
		And Pl.ExpirationDate Is Null
)
, CRiskLocation As
(
	 -- For CP Line level Coverages  we are using Primary Location as Risk Location fOr ISO Reporting fOr premium & Losses
     Select PP.ID							  As BranchID
		  , Pl.PublicID
	   From pc_policyperiod				  PP
	   Join pc_policylocation			  Pl  On PP.ID = Pl.BranchID
	   Join pc_EffectiveDatedfields		  Ef  On PP.ID = Ef.BranchID And Ef.PrimaryLocation = Pl.FixedID
        And ((Ef.EffectiveDate  Is Null)  Or (Coalesce(Ef.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) >= Coalesce(Pl.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart)))
        And ((Ef.ExpirationDate Is Null))
	  Where 1 = 1
	    And PP.ModelDate      Is Not Null
)
Select COUNT(Publicid) from (

Select Distinct
       T.ID																					  As GWRowNumber
	 , T.PublicID																			  As PublicID
	 , Coalesce(Ph.ID      , PP.ID            )                                               As BranchID
     , Coalesce(PH.PublicID, PP.PublicID, '-2')									              As PolicyNumberLkp
	 , Po.ProductCode
	 , A.TYPECODE
	 , IsNull(Uc.PublicID               , '-2')									              As CompanyLkp
	 , IsNull(ProdCode.PublicID         , '-2')								                  As ProducerLkp
	 , IsNull(GaExt.PublicID            , '-2')									              As AgencyLkp
	 , IsNull(Ac.PublicID               , '-2')										          As AccountLkp
	 , Coalesce(PLc.PublicID            , '-2')												  As RiskLocationLkp
	 , Case When	Pb.PublicID Is Not Null Then Concat(Pb.PublicID			  ,    '~CP')
	        When	Sc.PublicID Is Not Null Then Concat(Sc.PublicID			  ,    '~SC')
	   Else '-2' End																		  As BuildingLkp
	 , Case When	Bi.PublicID Is Not Null Then Concat(Bi.PublicID			  ,    '~BI')
	        When	Sb.PublicID Is Not Null Then Concat(Sb.PublicID			  ,   '~SBI')
		    When	 O.PublicID Is Not Null Then Concat( O.PublicID			  ,    '~OC')
	   Else '-2' End																		  As BuildingDetailsLkp
	 , Case When     p.PublicID Is Null     Then '-2'
	   Else Concat(p.PublicID           , '~PP')    End										  As PersonalPropertyLkp
	 , IsNull(Pl.PublicID               , '-2' )									          As LOBLkp
	 , IsNull(Pa.PublicID               , '-2' )									          As CoverageLkp
	 , Case When   Bsc.PublicID Is Not Null Then Concat(  Bsc.PublicID		  ,   '~BSC')
	        When  Bisc.PublicID Is Not Null Then Concat( Bisc.PublicID		  ,  '~BISC')
			When   Ssc.PublicID Is Not Null Then Concat(  Ssc.PublicID		  ,   '~SSC')
			When  Sbis.PublicID Is Not Null Then Concat( Sbis.PublicID		  , '~SBISC')
			When  PPsc.PublicID Is Not Null Then Concat( PPsc.PublicID		  ,  '~PPSC')
	   Else '-2' End																		  As ChildCoverageLkp
	 , IsNull(Pa.EffectiveDate       , PP.PeriodStart)										  As CoverageEffectiveDate
	 , IsNull(   Cast(Convert(Varchar, PP.PeriodStart	   , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999') As PolicyEffectiveDateLkp
	 , IsNull(   Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.EFFectiveDate	   , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999') As EffectiveDateLkp
	 , IsNull(   Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.ExpirationDate	   , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999') As ExpirationDateLkp
	 , IsNull(   Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.DateWritten	   , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999') As WrittendateLkp
	 , IsNull(   Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.DatePosted		   , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999') As PostedDateLkp
	 , Case When T.DatePosted Is Not Null
	 		Then Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.DatePosted   , 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.EffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
	 				  Then Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.DatePosted   , 101) As DateTime)
	 				  Else Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.EffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
	 			 End
	 		Else '12/31/9999'
	   End										                                              As RecognizedDate
	 , Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar, J.CloseDate         , 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, pp.editEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
                 Then Cast(Convert(Varchar, J.CloseDate    , 101) As DateTime)
            Else Cast(Convert(Varchar, pp.EditEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime) End			  As DWPRecognizedDate
	 , LSju.TypeCode																		  As LocationState

			When A.TypeCode Not In ('BGI', 'EQ') And Po.ProductCode = 'CP7CommercialProperty' Then 'Other'
			When A.TypeCode = 'EQ'                                                            Then 'EQ'
		    Else Null
	   End																					  As CostType

	          , Bic.PatternCode, Bisc.PatternCode, Scc.PatternCode,   Se.PatternCode, Ssc.PatternCode
			  , Sbi.PatternCode, Sbis.PatternCode,  Oc.PatternCode, PPsc.PatternCode,  Pc.PatternCode
			  , Case When A.TypeCode = 'CP7StateCost_Ext' Then 'CP7TaxesAndSurcharges'
			         Else Null
				End)                                                                          As PatternCode

	 , T.SpoilageLimit_Ext
	 , T.SpoilageRate_Ext
	 , T.CommissionRate
	 , T.CededRiskAmount
	 , T.CedingRate
                    , T.Commission
	 , T.CalcTimestamp

SOURCE_QUERY:
With CTE_HORT As
(
     Select Distinct
            Pt.PublicID
          , Coalesce(Cs.FixedID  , Cst.FixedID )                                          As CostFixedID
          , Coalesce(Cs.BranchID , Cst.BranchID)                                          As CostBranchID
          , Coalesce(ph.ID       , Pp.ID       )                                          As TransactionBranchID
          , Coalesce(ph.PublicID , pp.PublicID )                                          As PolicyNumberLKP
          , Coalesce(ph.ModelDate, pp.ModelDate)                                          As ModelDate

		  , Pt.CededPremium
	      , pt.BasisGNP
	      , pt.Commission
          , Pt.SpoilageLimit_Ext
          , Pt.SpoilageRate_Ext
          , Pt.CommissionRate
          , Pt.CededRiskAmount
          , Pt.CedingRate
          , Pt.CalcTimestamp
		  , Pt.DateWritten
		  , Pt.EffectiveDate
		  , Pt.ExpirationDate
		  , Pt.DatePosted
          , Pt.ID                                                                         As   GWRowNumber

		  , Rp.PublicID                                                                   As   ProgramPublicID
          , Ra.PublicID                                                                   As   AgreementPublicID
	      , TT.Name								                                          As   TreatyType
		  , IsNull(Case When Uc.PublicID = 'uwc:10' Then '-1' Else Uc.PublicID End, '-1') As   CompanyLkp
	      , IsNull(ProdCode.PublicID    , '-1')                                           As   ProducerLkp
          , IsNull(GaExt.PublicID       , '-1')                                           As   AgencyLkp
          , IsNull(Ac.PublicID          , '-1')                                           As   AccountLkp
		  , Po.ProductCode
          , Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar, Cj.CloseDate         , 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, PP.EditEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
                      Then Cast(Convert(Varchar, Cj.CloseDate    , 101) As DateTime)
                 Else Cast(Convert(Varchar, PP.EditEffectiveDate , 101) As DateTime) End  As   DWPRecognizedDate
          , PP.PeriodStart
		  , PP.PolicyNumber                                                               As CostPolicyNumber
          , PP.TermNumber                                                                 As CostTermNumber
		  , PP.EditEffectiveDate
		  , PP.ModelNumber

       From pcx_hocededpremiumtransaction Pt
  Left Join pcx_hocededpremium             E On Pt.HOCededPremium        = E.ID
  Left Join pcx_hocededpremiumhistory      H On Pt.HOCededPremiumHistory = H.ID
  /*17 Jan Start*/
  Left Join pc_RIProgram                  Rp On Pt.Program               = Rp.ID
  Left Join Pc_ReinsuranceAgreement       Ra On Pt.Agreement             = Ra.ID
  Left Join pctl_ritreatytype_ext		  TT On Ra.RITreatyType_Ext		 = TT.ID
  /* 17 Jan End*/

  Left Join pc_job                        Jh On Jh.JobNumber             = (Case When H.CommentText  Is Not Null Then Substring(CommentText, 11,10) Else Null End) --> Transaction Branch
  Left Join pc_policyperiod               Ph On Jh.ID                    = Ph.JobID And Ph.ModelDate Is Not Null
  Left Join pcx_homeownerscost_hoe        Cs On  E.HomeownersCost        = Cs.ID    And Cs.BranchID = Ph.ID
  Left Join pcx_homeownerscost_hoe       Cst On  E.HomeownersCost        = Cst.ID
  Left Join pc_policyperiod               PP On PP.ID                    = Coalesce(Cs.BranchID, Cst.BranchID) --> Cost Btanch
  /*17 Jan Start*/
  Left Join pc_job                        Cj On PP.JobID                  = Cj.ID             --> Cost Job
  Left Join pc_uwcompany                  Uc On PP.uwcompany              = Uc.ID
  Left Join pc_producercode         ProdCode On PP.ProducerCodeOfRecordID = ProdCode.ID
  Left Join pc_group                     Grp On ProdCode.Agency_Ext       = Grp.ID
  Left Join pcx_groupagency_ext        GaExt On grp.GroupAgency_Ext       = GaExt.ID
  Left Join pc_policy                     Po On PP.PolicyID               = Po.ID
  Left Join pc_account                    Ac On Po.AccountID              = Ac.ID
  /*17Jan end*/

      Where 1 = 1
        And PP.ModelDate   Is Not Null
        --And (Pt.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementDays, @RunDate)) -- Or PP.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementDays, @RunDate))
)



,Cost As

(

     Select Cs.Subtype,Cs.PublicID,Cs.EffectiveDate

          , Cs.StandardAmount      , Cs.StandardTermAmount  , Cs.StandardBaseRate    , Cs.StandardAdjRate

          , Cs.OverrideAmount      , Cs.OverrideTermAmount , Cs.OverrideBaseRate    , Cs.OverrideAdjRate , Cs.OverrideReason

,HOLineCov As

       Join pc_policyperiod           PP On Cs.BranchID = PP.ID

      Where 1 = 1

	    And PP.ModelDate   Is Not Null

        And Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, '9999-12-01')               <> Coalesce(Cs.ExpirationDate, '9999-12-31')

      --  And (Cs.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, -700, @RunDate))-- Or PP.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementDays, @RunDate))

          , Rank()       Over (Partition By FixedID, BranchID  Order By Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End Desc) As Rk

       From pcx_dwellingcov_hoe       Cs

      Where 1 = 1

	    And PP.ModelDate   Is Not Null

        And Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, '9999-12-01')               <> Coalesce(Cs.ExpirationDate, '9999-12-31')

      --  And (Cs.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, -700, @RunDate))-- Or PP.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementDays, @RunDate))

	    And Cs.BranchID  In (Select BranchID From Cost)



)



, Dwelling As

(

     Select Cs.FixedID, Cs.BranchID, Cs.PublicID

          , Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart)                                                                                                     <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End       As Ind

	    And Cs.BranchID  In (Select BranchID From Cost)



)



, HOLocation As

     Select Cs.BranchID, Cs. PolicyLocation

          , Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart)                                                                                                     <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End       As Ind

          , Row_Number() Over (Partition By FixedID, BranchID,          Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End Order By Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End Desc, Coalesce(Cs.ExpirationDate, '9999-12-31') Desc) As RN

          , Rank()       Over (Partition By FixedID, BranchID  Order By Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End Desc) As Rk

       From pcx_holocation_hoe        Cs

       Join pc_policyperiod           PP On Cs.BranchID = PP.ID

      Where 1 = 1

	    And PP.ModelDate   Is Not Null

        And Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, '9999-12-01')               <> Coalesce(Cs.ExpirationDate, '9999-12-31')

        --And (Cs.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, -700, @RunDate))-- Or PP.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementDays, @RunDate))

        And Cs.BranchID  In (Select BranchID From Cost)

)



, PolicyLocation As

(

     Select Cs.FixedID, Cs.BranchID, Cs.PublicID

          , Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart)                                                                                                     <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End       As Ind

          , Row_Number() Over (Partition By FixedID, BranchID,          Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End Order By Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End Desc, Coalesce(Cs.ExpirationDate, '9999-12-31') Desc) As RN

          , Rank()       Over (Partition By FixedID, BranchID  Order By Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End Desc) As Rk

       From pc_policylocation         Cs

      Where 1 = 1

	    And PP.ModelDate   Is Not Null

        And Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, '9999-12-01')               <> Coalesce(Cs.ExpirationDate, '9999-12-31')

        --And (Cs.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, -700, @RunDate))-- Or PP.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementDays, @RunDate))

        And Cs.BranchID  In (Select BranchID From Cost)



)

, PolicyLine As

(

     Select Cs.FixedID, Cs.BranchID, Cs.PublicID

          , Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart)                                                                                                     <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End       As Ind

          , Row_Number() Over (Partition By FixedID, BranchID,          Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End Order By Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End Desc, Coalesce(Cs.ExpirationDate, '9999-12-31') Desc) As RN

          , Rank()       Over (Partition By FixedID, BranchID  Order By Case When Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart) <= PP.EditEffectiveDate Then 1 Else 0 End Desc) As Rk

       From pc_policyline             Cs

       Join pc_policyperiod           PP On Cs.BranchID = PP.ID

      Where 1 = 1

	    And PP.ModelDate   Is Not Null

        And Coalesce(Cs.EffectiveDate, '9999-12-01')               <> Coalesce(Cs.ExpirationDate, '9999-12-31')

      --  And (Cs.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, -700, @RunDate))-- Or PP.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementDays, @RunDate))

		And Cs.BranchID  In (Select BranchID From Cost)

)
Select COUNT(Publicid) from (
Select Distinct

	   C.GWRownumber

	 , C.PublicID

	 , C.CostFixedID

     , Dw.FixedID                                                                                                                                                  As   DwellingFixedID

     , Cast((Convert(Varchar(10), C.EditEffectiveDate, 121) + ' ' + '00:00:00.' + Right( '00' + Cast(C.ModelNumber    As Varchar(2)), 3)) As DateTime2)          As   DataEffectiveDate



	, Hoc.Subtype

     , C.CostBranchID                                                                                                                                              As   BranchID

     , IsNull(C.PolicyNumberLKP           , '-1')																												   As   PolicyNumberLkp

	 , C.CostPolicyNumber                 As CostPolicyNumber

     , C.CostTermNumber                   As CostTermNumber

	 , C.ProductCode

	 , C.TreatyType					                                                                                                                               As   TreatyType

	 , IsNull(C.CompanyLkp          , '-1')						                                                                                 				   As   CompanyLkp

	 , IsNull(C.ProducerLkp         , '-1')                                                                                                                        As   ProducerLkp

     , IsNull(C.AgencyLkp           , '-1')                                                                                                                        As   AgencyLkp

     , IsNull(C.AccountLkp          , '-1')                                                                                                                        As   AccountLkp



	 , IsNull(Polloc.PublicID       , '-1')                                                                                                                        As   RiskLocationLkp

     , IsNull(Pl.PublicID           , '-1')                                                                                                                        As   LOBLkp

     , IsNull(Hoc.PublicID          , '-1')                                                                                                                        As   CoverageLkp

	 , IsNull(Dw.PublicID           , '-1')                                                                                                                        As   DwellingLkp

     , Case When Ccst.Name          = 'HOTaxCost_HOE' Then 'HOTaxesAndSurcharges' Else IsNull(Hoex.Name, '-1') End												   As   HOPeril

	 , IsNull(Hoc.EffectiveDate     , C.PeriodStart)                                                                                                              As   CoverageEffectiveDate

     , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar , C.PeriodStart   , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')																		   As   PolicyEffectiveDateLkp





	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar , C.DateWritten   , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')																		   As   WrittendateLkp

     , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar , C.EffectiveDate , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')																		   As   EffectiveDateLkp

     , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar , C.ExpirationDate, 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')																		   As   ExpirationDateLkp

     , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar , C.DatePosted    , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')																		   As   PostedDateLkp

     , IsNull(Dw.PublicID           , '-1')                                                                                                                        As   HODwellingLkp

     , Case When C.DatePosted Is Not Null

                 Then Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar, C.DatePosted, 101) As DateTime) >    Cast(Convert(Varchar, C.EffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)

                           Then Cast(Convert(Varchar, C.DatePosted, 101) As DateTime) Else Cast(Convert(Varchar, C.EffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)

                       End

            Else '12/31/9999'

       End																																						   As   RecognizedDate

    , C.DWPRecognizedDate                                                                                                                                          As   DWPRecognizedDate



    , Case When Ccst.Name In ('DwellingCovCost_HOE', 'DWSchedCovItemCovCost_Ext', 'HomeownersBaseCost_HOE', 'HomeownersCovCost_HOE', 'HOSchedCovItemCovCost_Ext') Then Coalesce(Holc.PatternCode, Dwc.PatternCode)

           When Ccst.Name = 'HOTaxCost_HOE'                                                                                                                       Then 'HOTaxesAndSurcharges'

       End                                                                                                                                                         As   PatternCode

     , C.CededPremium

	 , C.BasisGNP

	 , C.Commission

     , C.SpoilageLimit_Ext

     , C.SpoilageRate_Ext

     , C.CommissionRate

     , C.CededRiskAmount

     , C.CedingRate

     , C.CalcTimestamp

     , C.DateWritten

     , C.DatePosted

	 , C.ProgramPublicID                                                                                                                                           As   ProgramPublicID

     , C.AgreementPublicID                                                                                                                                         As   AgreementPublicID



     , Ccst.Name                                                                                                                                                   As   HOCostSubtype

     , Hoc.Basis                                                                                                                                                   As   Basis

     , Hoc.ActualAmount                                                                                                                                            As   ActualAmount

     , Hoc.ActualTermAmount                                                                                                                                        As   ActualTermAmount

     , Hoc.ActualBaseRate                                                                                                                                          As   ActualBaseRate

     , Hoc.ActualAdjRate                                                                                                                                           As   ActualAdjRate

     , Hoc.StandardAmount                                                                                                                                          As   StandardAmount

     , Hoc.StandardTermAmount                                                                                                                                      As   StandardTermAmount

     , Hoc.StandardBaseRate                                                                                                                                        As   StandardBaseRate

     , Hoc.StandardAdjRate                                                                                                                                         As   StandardAdjRate

     , Hoc.OverrideAmount                                                                                                                                          As   OverrideAmount

     , Hoc.OverrideTermAmount                                                                                                                                      As   OverrideTermAmount

     , Hoc.OverrideBaseRate                                                                                                                                        As   OverrideBaseRate

     , Hoc.OverrideAdjRate                                                                                                                                         As   OverrideAdjRate

     , Hoc.OverrideReason                                                                                                                                          As   OverrideReason

     , Hoc.NodiscountAmount_Ext_amt                                                                                                                                As   NoDiscountAmount

     , Hoc.NodiscountTermAmount_Ext_amt                                                                                                                            As   NoDiscountTermAmount

     , Hoc.Subline_ext                                                                                                                                             As   Subline



From CTE_HORT C

  Left Join Cost                         Hoc On C.CostFixedID             = Hoc.FixedID    And Hoc.BranchID =  C.CostBranchID And ((   Hoc.Ind = 1 And    Hoc.Rk = 1 And    Hoc.Rn = 1) Or (   Hoc.Ind = 0 And    Hoc.Rk = 1 And    Hoc.Rn = 1))

  Left Join pctl_homeownerscost_hoe     CCst On Hoc.Subtype               = Ccst.ID

  Left Join pctl_hoexposurecode_ext     Hoex On Hoc.ExposureCode          = Hoex.ID

  Left Join HOLineCov                   Holc On Hoc.HomeownersLineCov     = Holc.FixedID   And Hoc.BranchID =   Holc.BranchID And ((  Holc.Ind = 1 And   Holc.Rk = 1 And   Holc.Rn = 1) Or (  Holc.Ind = 0 And   Holc.Rk = 1 And   Holc.Rn = 1))

  Left Join DwellingCov                  Dwc On Hoc.DwellingCov           = Dwc.FixedID    And Hoc.BranchID =    Dwc.BranchID And ((   Dwc.Ind = 1 And    Dwc.Rk = 1 And    Dwc.Rn = 1) Or (   Dwc.Ind = 0 And    Dwc.Rk = 1 And    Dwc.Rn = 1))

  Left Join Dwelling                      Dw On Dwc.Dwelling              = Dw.FixedID     And Hoc.BranchID =     Dw.BranchID And ((    Dw.Ind = 1 And     Dw.Rk = 1 And     Dw.Rn = 1) Or (    Dw.Ind = 0 And     Dw.Rk = 1 And     Dw.Rn = 1))

  Left Join HOLocation                   Hol On Hoc.BranchID              = Hol.BranchID   And									  ((Hol.Ind    = 1 And    Hol.Rk = 1 And    Hol.Rn = 1) Or (   Hol.Ind = 0 And    Hol.Rk = 1 And    Hol.Rn = 1))

  Left Join PolicyLocation            Polloc On Hol.PolicyLocation        = Polloc.FixedID And Hoc.BranchID = Polloc.BranchID And ((Polloc.Ind = 1 And Polloc.Rk = 1 And Polloc.Rn = 1) Or (Polloc.Ind = 0 And Polloc.Rk = 1 And Polloc.Rn = 1))

  Left Join PolicyLine                    Pl On Hoc.HomeownersLine        = Pl.FixedID     And Hoc.BranchID =     Pl.BranchID And ((    Pl.Ind = 1 And     Pl.Rk = 1 And     Pl.Rn = 1) Or (    Pl.Ind = 0 And     Pl.Rk = 1 And     Pl.Rn = 1))
  ) as main;

	 , IsNull(pl.PublicID      , '-2')												  As LOBLkp
	 , IsNull(pa.PublicID      , '-2')												  As CoverageLkp
	 , Cast(IsNull(pa.EffectiveDate,pp.PeriodStart)	As DateTime)				      As CoverageEffectiveDate
	 , IsNull(crms.PublicID    , '-2')												  As ReinsuranceIDLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar, pp.PeriodStart, 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999') As PolicyEffectiveDateLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar, pt.WrittEnDate, 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999') As WrittEnDateLkp
     , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar, pt.EFFDate    , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999') As EffectiveDateLkp
     , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar, pt.EXPDate    , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999') As ExpirationDateLkp
     , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar, pt.PostedDate , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999') As PostedDateLkp
     , pt.Amount
     , pt.AmountBilling
     , pt.PublicID
     , Case When pt.Written = 1 Then 'Y' Else 'N' End                                 As Written
	 , Cast(pt.BeanVersion             As   Varchar(30))                              As BeanVersion
	 , pt.AmountBilling * (DateDiff(d, Cast(pp.PeriodStart As Date), Cast(pp.PeriodEnd As Date)) / Cast((DateDiff(dd, Cast(pt.EffDate As Date), Cast(pt.ExpDate As Date))) As Decimal(15, 8))) As InforcePremium
     , Case When pt.PostedDate Is Not Null  Then
	             Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar, pt.PostedDate, 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, pt.EffDate, 101) As DateTime)
                      Then Cast(Convert(Varchar, pt.PostedDate, 101) As DateTime)
                      Else Cast(Convert(Varchar, pt.EffDate   , 101) As DateTime)
                  End
        Else '12/31/9999' End														  As RecognizedDate
          , Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar, j.closedate, 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, pp.editEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
                     Then Cast(Convert(Varchar, j.closedate, 101) As DateTime)
                Else Cast(Convert(Varchar, pp.editEffectiveDate, 101)         As DateTime) End       As DWPRecognizedDate
	 , 'IM1'																	      As ProductLkp
  From pc_imtransaction pt
  Join pc_policyperiod  pp  On  pt.BranchID = pp.ID
  Join pc_imcost        pa  On  pt.IMCost = pa.ID
-----COVERAGES-----
--Reinsurance
   Left Join pcx_facreinsuranceagrdtl_ext                        crms On pa.AgreementDetail = crms.FixedID              And pa.branchid  = crms.branchid
    And ((crms.EffectiveDate                  Is Null) Or ( Coalesce(Cast(crms.EffectiveDate               As Date), pp.PeriodStart)    <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
    And ((crms.ExpirationDate                 Is Null) Or ( Cast(crms.ExpirationDate                       As Date)                      > Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
--IMBasePartExclCost_Ext--
   Left Join[dbo].[pcx_imbasepartexclusion_ext]            baseprtexl On pa.partexclusion  = baseprtexl.fixedID         And pa.branchid  = baseprtexl.branchid
    And ((baseprtexl.EffectiveDate            Is Null) Or ( Coalesce(Cast(baseprtexl.EffectiveDate         As Date), pp.PeriodStart)    <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
    And (( baseprtexl.ExpirationDate          Is Null) Or ( Cast(baseprtexl.ExpirationDate                 As Date)                      > Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
--IMBasePartCondCost_Ext--
   Left Join[dbo].[pcx_imbasepartcondition_ex]            baseprtcond On pa.partcondition  = baseprtcond.fixedID        And pa.branchid  = baseprtcond.branchid
    And ((baseprtcond.EffectiveDate           Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(baseprtcond.EffectiveDate         As Date), pp.PeriodStart)    <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
    And (( baseprtcond.ExpirationDate         Is Null) Or (Cast(baseprtcond.ExpirationDate                 As Date)                      > Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
-- IMBaseSchedCovItemCovCost_Ext --
   Left Join[dbo].[pcx_imbaseschedcovitemcov_ext] baseschedcovitemcov On pa.itemcoverage   = baseschedcovitemcov.fixedID And pa.branchid = baseschedcovitemcov.branchid
    And ((baseschedcovitemcov.EffectiveDate   Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(baseschedcovitemcov.EffectiveDate As Date), pp.PeriodStart)    <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
    And (( baseschedcovitemcov.ExpirationDate Is Null) Or (Cast(baseschedcovitemcov.ExpirationDate         As Date)                      > Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
--IMBasePartCovCombCost_Ext
   Left Join[dbo].[pcx_imbaseschedcovitmcomb_ext]         baseprtcomb On pa.itmcomb        = baseprtcomb.fixedID        And pa.branchid  = baseprtcomb.branchid
    And ((baseprtcomb.EffectiveDate           Is Null) Or ( Coalesce(Cast(baseprtcomb.EffectiveDate        As Date), pp.PeriodStart)    <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
    And (( baseprtcomb.ExpirationDate         Is Null) Or ( Cast(baseprtcomb.ExpirationDate                As Date)                      > Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
--IMBasePartCovCost_Ext --
   Left Join[dbo].[pcx_imbasepartcoverage_ext]             baseprtcov On pa.partcoverage   = baseprtcov.fixedID         And pa.branchid  = baseprtcov.branchid
    And ((baseprtcov.EffectiveDate            Is Null) Or ( Coalesce(Cast(baseprtcov.EffectiveDate         As Date), pp.PeriodStart)    <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
    And (( baseprtcov.ExpirationDate          Is Null) Or ( Cast(baseprtcov.ExpirationDate                 As Date)                      > Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
--Building&Location---
   Left Join[dbo].[pcx_imbaseschedcovitem_ext]		 baseschedcovitem On baseschedcovitemcov.item = baseschedcovitem.fixedID And  pa.branchid = baseschedcovitem.branchid
    And ((baseschedcovitem.EffectiveDate      Is Null) Or ( Coalesce(Cast(baseschedcovitem.EffectiveDate   As Date), pp.PeriodStart)    <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
    And (( baseschedcovitem.ExpirationDate    Is Null) Or ( Cast(baseschedcovitem.ExpirationDate           As Date)                      > Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
   Left Join[dbo].pc_IMBuilding							            b On  (baseschedcovitem.IMBuilding     = b.FixedID) And pa.branchid  = b.branchid
    And ((b.EffectiveDate					  Is Null) Or ( Coalesce(Cast(b.EffectiveDate				   As Date), pp.PeriodStart)    <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
    And (( b.ExpirationDate					  Is Null) Or ( Cast(b.ExpirationDate						   As Date)                      > Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
   Left Join[dbo].pc_IMLocation						                l On  b.IMLocation = l.FixedID				        And pa.branchid  = l.branchid
    And ((l.EffectiveDate					  Is Null) Or ( Coalesce(Cast(l.EffectiveDate                  As Date), pp.PeriodStart)    <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
    And ((l.ExpirationDate					  Is Null) Or ( Cast(l.ExpirationDate                          As Date)                      > Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
   Left Join[dbo].pc_policylocation							   polloc On  Coalesce(baseschedcovitem.IMLocation,l.Location)				 = polloc.fixedid And pa.branchid         = polloc.branchid
    And ((polloc.EffectiveDate				  Is Null) Or ( Coalesce(Cast(polloc.EffectiveDate			   As Date), pp.PeriodStart)    <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
    And (( polloc.ExpirationDate			  Is Null) Or ( Cast(polloc.ExpirationDate                     As Date)                      > Coalesce(pt.EffDate,pp.PeriodStart)))
   Left Join pc_uwcompany										   uc On  pp.uwcompany				= uc.ID
   Left Join pc_producercode								 prodcode On  pp.ProducerCodeOfRecordID = prodcode.ID
   Left Join pc_group											  grp On  prodcode.Agency_Ext       = grp.ID
   Left Join pcx_groupagency_ext								gaext On  grp.GroupAgency_Ext       = gaext.ID
   Left Join pc_policy											   po On  pp.PolicyID				= po.ID
   Left Join pc_policyline										   pl On  pl.BranchID			    = pa.BranchID      And pa.InlandMarineLine = pl.FixedID
    And ((pl.EffectiveDate	Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(pl.EffectiveDate As Date), pp.PeriodStart)  <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
    And ((pl.ExpirationDate Is Null) Or (Cast(pl.ExpirationDate			As Date)					> Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
   Left Join pc_account											   ac On  po.AccountID              = ac.ID
   Left Join pc_EffectiveDatedfields                               ef On  pp.ID                     = ef.BranchID And ef.PrimaryLocation = pl.FixedID
    And ((ef.EffectiveDate  Is Null) Or (Coalesce(ef.EffectiveDate, pp.PeriodStart)				   <= Coalesce(pl.EffectiveDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
    And ((ef.ExpirationDate Is Null) Or (ef.ExpirationDate										    > Coalesce(pl.EffectiveDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
   Left Join pc_job													j On  pp.JobID					= j.ID
   Left Join pctl_job											  jtl On  j.Subtype				    = jtl.ID
   Left Join pctl_policyperiodstatus							  pps On  pp.Status				    = pps.ID
   Join pctl_imcost												 ccst On  pa.Subtype				= ccst.ID
  Where 1 = 1
    And ((pp.ModelDate Is Not Null)OR (jtl.name = 'Audit' And pps.NAME = 'Completed'))
    --And   pt.UpDateTime >= Dateadd(d,?,getDate())
) as main;

SOURCE_QUERY:
With ContactType As
(
	  Select AccountID
	       , ContactType
	    From (
			   Select Acct.ID As AccountID
				    , C.Name  As ContactType
				    , Row_Number() Over (Partition By Acct.ID Order By Ac.AccountID) As RowNumber
			     From bc_account            Acct
			Left Join bc_accountcontact     Ac       On Acct.ID               =  Ac.AccountID        And  Ac.Retired = 0
			Left Join bc_accountcontactrole Acr      On   Ac.ID               = Acr.AccountContactID And Acr.Retired = 0
			Left Join bc_contact            Ct       On   Ac.ContactID        =  Ct.ID
			Left Join bctl_accountrole      Ar       On  Acr.Role             =  Ar.ID
			Left Join bctl_contact          C        On   Ct.Subtype          =   C.ID
			    Where Ar.Name = 'Insured'
		     )c
	   Where RowNumber = 1
)
, PolicyPeriod As
(
	  Select PP.HiddenTAccountContainerID
	       , IsNull(ProdCode.Code      , '-2')		 As ProducerCode
		   , IsNull(Prod.AgencyCode_Ext, '-2')		 As Agency
		   , Acc.AccountNumber
		   , IsNull(Acc.PublicID       , '-2')		 As lkp_BillingAccountID
		   , IsNull(PP.TermNumber      , '-2')		 As TermNumber
		   , IsNull(PP.PolicyNumber    , '-2')		 As PolicyNumber
		   , Cast(IsNull(Cast(PP.PolicyPerEffDate    As Date), '1900-01-01') As Varchar(50)) As EffectiveDate
		   , Cast(IsNull(Cast(PP.PolicyPerExpirDate  As Date), '1900-01-01') As Varchar(50)) As ExpirationDate
		   , IsNull(Billpl.PublicID    , '-2')		 As lkp_BillingPlanID
		   , IsNull( Paypl.PublicID    , '-2')		 As lkp_PaymentPlanID
		   ,    Uwc.TypeCode                 	     As lkp_CompanyCode
		   , pp.UpdateTime
	    From bc_policyperiod		        PP
	    Join bc_policy			            Pol		 On PP.PolicyID			  = Pol.ID
	    Join bc_account				        Acc		 On Pol.AccountID	      = Acc.ID
   Left Join bc_policycommission            Pcom	 On Pcom.PolicyPeriodID   =  PP.ID  And Pcom.EndDate Is Null
   Left Join bc_producercode                ProdCode On Pcom.ProducerCodeID   = ProdCode.ID
   Left Join bc_producer			        Prod	 On ProdCode.ProducerID   = Prod.ID
   Left Join bc_plan				        Billpl   On Billpl.ID		      = Acc.BillingPlanID
   Left Join bc_plan				        Paypl	 On Paypl.ID		      = PP.PaymentPlanID
   Left Join bctl_policyrole		        Tlpr	 On Pcom.Role		      = TlPr.ID And TlPr.TypeCode='primary'
   Left Join bctl_uwcompany	                Uwc		 On PP.UWCompany		  = Uwc.ID
   Left Join ContactType                    Ct       On Acc.ID                = Ct.AccountID

)
, ProducerCode As
(
      Select ProdCode.HiddenTAccountContainerID
	       , IsNull(ProdCode.Code      , '-2')       As ProducerCode
		   , IsNull(Prod.AgencyCode_Ext, '-2')       As Agency
		   , ProdCode.UpdateTime
        From bc_producercode                ProdCode
   Left Join bc_producer                    Prod     On ProdCode.ProducerID   = Prod.ID
)

, PolComm As
(
	  Select Pcom.HiddenTAccountContainerID
	       , Acc.AccountNumber
	  	   , IsNull(ProdCode.Code      , '-2')		 As ProducerCode
	  	   , IsNull(Prod.AgencyCode_Ext, '-2')		 As Agency
	  	   , IsNull(Acc.PublicID       , '-2')		 As lkp_BillingAccountID
	  	   , IsNull(PP.TermNumber      , '-2')		 As TermNumber
	  	   , IsNull(PP.PolicyNumber    , '-2')		 As PolicyNumber
	  	   , Cast(IsNull(Cast(PP.PolicyPerEffDate    As Date), '1900-01-01') As Varchar(50)) As EffectiveDate
	  	   , Cast(IsNull(Cast(PP.PolicyPerExpirDate  As Date), '1900-01-01') As Varchar(50)) As ExpirationDate
	  	   , IsNull(Billpl.PublicID    , '-2')		 As lkp_BillingPlanID
	  	   , IsNull( Paypl.PublicID    , '-2')		 As lkp_PaymentPlanID
	  	   , Uwc.TypeCode                    	     As lkp_CompanyCode
	  	   , Pcom.UpdateTime
	    From bc_policycommission            Pcom  --199
   Left Join bc_producercode                ProdCode On Pcom.ProducerCodeID   = ProdCode.ID
   Left Join bc_producer		            Prod	 On ProdCode.ProducerID   = Prod.ID
   Left Join bc_policyperiod                PP	     On Pcom.PolicyPeriodID   = PP.ID
   Left Join bc_policy		                Pol	     On PP.PolicyID		      = Pol.ID
   Left Join bc_account		                Acc	     On Pol.AccountID		  = Acc.ID
   Left Join bc_plan			            Billpl   On Billpl.ID		      = Acc.BillingPlanID
   Left Join bc_plan			            Paypl    On Paypl.ID		      = PP.PaymentPlanID
   Left Join bctl_uwcompany                 Uwc      On PP.UWCompany		  = Uwc.ID
   Left Join ContactType                    Ct       On Acc.ID                = Ct.AccountID
)
, ChargeComm As
(
      Select cc.HiddenTAccountContainerID
	       , Acc.AccountNumber
		   , IsNull(ProdCode.Code      , '-2')		 As ProducerCode
		   , IsNull(Prod.AgencyCode_Ext, '-2')		 As Agency
		   , IsNull(Acc.PublicID       , '-2')		 As lkp_BillingAccountID
		   , IsNull(PP.TermNumber      , '-2')		 As TermNumber
		   , IsNull(PP.PolicyNumber    , '-2')		 As PolicyNumber
		   , Cast(IsNull(Cast(PP.PolicyPerEffDate    As Date), '1900-01-01') As Varchar(50)) As  EffectiveDate
		   , Cast(IsNull(Cast(PP.PolicyPerExpirDate  As Date), '1900-01-01') As Varchar(50)) As  ExpirationDate
		   , IsNull(Billpl.PublicID    , '-2')		 As lkp_BillingPlanID
		   , IsNull( Paypl.PublicID    , '-2')		 As lkp_PaymentPlanID
		   ,  Uwc.TypeCode                       	 As lkp_CompanyCode
		   , cc.UpdateTime
	    From bc_chargecommission		    Cc
   Left Join bc_policycommission            Pcom     On Cc.PolicyCommissionID = Pcom.ID
   Left Join bc_producercode                ProdCode On Pcom.ProducerCodeID   = ProdCode.ID
   Left Join bc_producer			        Prod	 On ProdCode.ProducerID   = Prod.ID
   Left Join bc_policyperiod		        PP		 On Pcom.PolicyPeriodID   = PP.ID
   Left Join bc_policy		                Pol		 On PP.PolicyID			  = Pol.ID
   Left Join bc_account			            Acc		 On Pol.AccountID		  = Acc.ID
   Left Join bc_plan				        Billpl   On Billpl.ID			  = Acc.BillingPlanID
   Left Join bc_plan				        Paypl    On Paypl.ID			  = PP.PaymentPlanID
   Left Join bctl_uwcompany	                Uwc      On PP.UWCompany		  = Uwc.ID
   Left Join ContactType                    Ct       On Acc.ID                = Ct.AccountID
)
, Collateral As
(
	  Select Col.HiddenTAccountContainerID
	       , Acc.AccountNumber
		   , IsNull(Acc.PublicID       , '-2')       As lkp_BillingAccountID
		   , IsNull(Billpl.PublicID    , '-2')       As lkp_BillingPlanID

		   , Col.UpdateTime
        From bc_collateral                  Col
   Left Join bc_account                     Acc		 On Col.AccountID         = Acc.ID
   Left Join bc_plan                        Billpl	 On Billpl.ID             = Acc.BillingPlanID
   Left Join ContactType                    Ct       On Acc.ID                = Ct.AccountID
)
, CollateralReq As
(
      Select Colr.HiddenTAccountContainerID
	       , Acc.AccountNumber
		   , IsNull(Acc.PublicID       , '-2')       As lkp_BillingAccountID
		   , IsNull(Billpl.PublicID    , '-2')       As lkp_BillingPlanID

		   , Colr.UpdateTime
        From bc_collateralrequirement       Colr
        Join bc_collateral			        Col      On Colr.CollateralID     = Col.ID
        Join bc_account				        Acc      On Col.AccountID	      = Acc.ID
   Left Join bc_plan					    Billpl   On Billpl.ID			  = Acc.BillingPlanID
   Left Join ContactType                    Ct       On Acc.ID                = Ct.AccountID
)
, SuspensePayment As
(
	  Select Spp.HiddenTAccountContainerID
	       , Acc.AccountNumber
		   , IsNull(Acc.PublicID       , '-2')       As lkp_BillingAccountID
		   , IsNull(Billpl.PublicID    , '-2')       As lkp_BillingPlanID
	       , IsNull(PP.TermNumber      , '-2')       As TermNumber
		   , IsNull(PP.PolicyNumber    , '-2')       As PolicyNumber
		   , Cast(IsNull(Cast(PP.PolicyPerEffDate    As Date), '1900-01-01') As Varchar(50)) As  EffectiveDate
		   , Cast(IsNull(Cast(PP.PolicyPerExpirDate  As Date), '1900-01-01') As Varchar(50)) As  ExpirationDate
		   , IsNull(Pr.AgencyCode_Ext  , '-2')       As Agency
		   , Uwc.TypeCode                            As lkp_CompanyCode
		   , spp.UpdateTime
	    From bc_suspensepayment             Spp
   Left Join bc_account                     Acc	     On Spp.AccountNumber     = Acc.AccountNumber
   Left Join bc_policyperiod                PP	     On Spp.PolicyNumber      = PP.PolicyNumber
   Left Join bc_producer		            Pr	     On Spp.ProducerName      = Pr.Name
   Left Join bc_plan			            Billpl   On Billpl.ID		      = Acc.BillingPlanID
   Left Join bctl_uwcompany                 Uwc      On PP.UWCompany          = Uwc.ID
   Left Join ContactType                    Ct       On Acc.ID                = Ct.AccountID
)
, Result As
(
      Select Trx.PublicID											  As   TransactionPublicID
	       , ILi.PublicID
	       , Cast(Concat(ILi.BeanVersion, Trx.BeanVersion) As Varchar(20)) As BeanVersion
	       , 1														  As   IsActive
	       , Tacpow.TAccountOwner
	       , ILi.ID												  	  As   GWRowNumber
	       , ILi.Amount                                               As   Amount
		   , lds.NAME                                                 As   LedgerSide
           , Li.PublicID											  As   lkp_BillingTransactionID
           , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'Account'			      Then IsNull(   Acc.PublicID,'-2')
		          When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'Collateral'			  Then           Col.lkp_BillingAccountID
		          When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'		  Then            PP.lkp_BillingAccountID
		          When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'	  Then       Polcomm.lkp_BillingAccountID
		          When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'	  Then            Cc.lkp_BillingAccountID
		          When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'CollateralRequirement' Then          Colr.lkp_BillingAccountID
		          When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'	      Then        Suspmt.lkp_BillingAccountID
             Else '-2'											  End As   lkp_BillingAccountID

	      ,  Uw.TypeCode                                             As   lkp_CompanyCode

	       , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'		  Then            PP.ProducerCode
	       	      When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ProducerCode'		  Then            Pc.ProducerCode
	       		  When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'	  Then       Polcomm.ProducerCode
	       	      When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'	  Then            CC.ProducerCode
             Else '-2'			                                  End As   lkp_ProducerID
	       , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'		  Then            PP.Agency
			      When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ProducerCode'		  Then            Pc.Agency
		          When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'Producer'			  Then IsNull(  Prod.AgencyCode_Ext, '-1')
		          When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'	  Then       Polcomm.Agency
		          When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'	  Then            Cc.Agency
		          When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'		  Then        Suspmt.Agency
             Else '-2'			                                  End As   lkp_AgencyID
           , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'		  Then            PP.TermNumber
	       		  When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'	  Then       Polcomm.TermNumber
	       		  When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'	  Then            Cc.TermNumber
	       		  When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'		  Then        Suspmt.TermNumber
             Else '-2'			                                  End As   TermNumber
	       , Cast(
	         Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'		  Then            PP.EffectiveDate
	       		  When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'	  Then       Polcomm.EffectiveDate
	       		  When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'	  Then            Cc.EffectiveDate
	       		  When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'		  Then        Suspmt.EffectiveDate
             Else '1900-01-01'       End As Date)                     As   EffectiveDate
	       , Cast(
	         Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'		  Then            PP.ExpirationDate
	       	      When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'	  Then       Polcomm.ExpirationDate
	       	      When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'	  Then            Cc.ExpirationDate
	       	      When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'		  Then        Suspmt.ExpirationDate
             Else '1900-01-01'        End As Date)                    As   ExpirationDate
	       , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'		  Then            PP.PolicyNumber
	       	      When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'	  Then       Polcomm.PolicyNumber
	       	      When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'	  Then            Cc.PolicyNumber
	       	      When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'		  Then        Suspmt.PolicyNumber
             Else '-2'                                            End As   PolicyNumber
           , u.PublicID						                          As   lkp_CreateUserID

        Join bc_transaction			        Trx			On Li.TransactionID			     =    Trx.ID
        Join bctl_transaction		        Btrx		On Trx.Subtype				     =   Btrx.ID
        Join bc_taccount			        Tac			On Li.TAccountID			     =    Tac.ID
   Left Join bctl_ledgerside	            Lds			On ILi.[Type]					 =    Lds.ID
        Join bc_TAccountPattern		        Tacptr		On Tac.TAccountPatternID		 = Tacptr.ID
        Join bc_TAcctOwnerPattern           Tacpow		On Tacptr.TAccountOwnerPatternID = Tacpow.ID
        Join bctl_taccount		            Btac		On Tac.Subtype					 =   Btac.ID
   Left Join bc_account			            Acc			On Tac.TAccountContainerID		 = Acc.HiddenTAccountContainerID
   Left Join bc_plan			            Billpl		On Billpl.ID					 = Acc.BillingPlanID
   Left Join Collateral			            Col			On Tac.TAccountContainerID		 = Col.HiddenTAccountContainerID
   Left Join PolicyPeriod		            PP			On Tac.TAccountContainerID		 = PP.HiddenTAccountContainerID
   Left Join PolComm			            Polcomm		On Tac.TAccountContainerID		 = Polcomm.HiddenTAccountContainerID
   Left Join bc_producer		            Prod		On Tac.TAccountContainerID		 = Prod.HiddenTAccountContainerID
   Left Join ProducerCode		            Pc			On Tac.TAccountContainerID		 = Pc.HiddenTAccountContainerID
   Left Join SuspensePayment	            Suspmt		On Tac.TAccountContainerID		 = Suspmt.HiddenTAccountContainerID
   Left Join ChargeComm		                Cc			On Tac.TAccountContainerID		 = CC.HiddenTAccountContainerID
   Left Join CollateralReq		            Colr		On Tac.TAccountContainerID		 = Colr.HiddenTAccountContainerID
   Left Join bc_revtrans		            TxnReversal On Trx.ID						 = TxnReversal.OwnerID
   Left Join bc_transfertxcontext           TxnTrnsfr   On Coalesce(TxnReversal.ForeignEntityID, Trx.ID) = TxnTrnsfr.TransactionID
   Left Join bc_fundstransfer	            FundsTrnsfr On TxnTrnsfr.FundsTransferID     = FundsTrnsfr.ID
   Left Join bctl_transferreason            Trfrsn		On FundsTrnsfr.Reason			 =      Trfrsn.ID
   Left Join bctl_reversalreason            Rvrsn		On Trx.ReversalReason			 =       Rvrsn.ID
   Left Join bctl_taccounttype              Taptype		On Tacptr.TAccountType			 =     Taptype.ID

	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar, pt.EXPDate    , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')						  As ExpirationDateLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert( Varchar, pt.PostedDate , 101) As DateTime), '12/31/9999')				          As PostedDateLkp
	 , IsNull(fr.PublicID      , '-2') As ReinsuranceIDLkp
	 , pt.Amount
	 , pt.AmountBilling
	 , pt.PublicID
	 , Case When pt.Written = 1 Then 'Y' Else 'N' End														  As Written
	 , Cast(pt.BeanVersion			   As   Varchar(30))                                                      As BeanVersion
	 , pt.AmountBilling * (DateDiff(d, Cast(pp.PeriodStart As Date), Cast(pp.PeriodEnd As Date)) / Cast((DateDiff(dd, Cast(pt.EffDate As Date), Cast(pt.ExpDate As Date))) As Decimal(15, 8))) As InforcePremium--defect:5872
     , Case When pt.PostedDate Is Not Null  Then Case When Cast(Convert(   Varchar, pt.PostedDate, 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, pt.EffDate, 101) As DateTime)
	   	    Then Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar, pt.PostedDate       , 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, pp.EditEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
	   		          Then Cast(Convert(Varchar, pt.PostedDate       , 101) As DateTime)
	   		          Else Cast(Convert(Varchar, pp.EditEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
	   	         End
	   	    Else Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar, pt.EffDate          , 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, pp.EditEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
	                  Then Cast(Convert(Varchar, pt.EffDate          , 101) As DateTime)
	   				  Else Cast(Convert(Varchar, pp.EditEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
                 End
             End
            Else '12/31/9999'
       End							   As RecognizedDate
  , Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar, j.closedate, 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, pp.editEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
                     Then Cast(Convert(Varchar, j.closedate, 101) As DateTime)
                Else Cast(Convert(Varchar, pp.editEffectiveDate, 101)         As DateTime) End       As DWPRecognizedDate
	 , Coalesce(Case When WC7CoveredEmployeeRateDev Is Not Null												   Then stt.TypeCode
	 				 When WC7WorkersCompCov			Is Not Null And WC7CoveredEmployee		      Is Not Null  Then stt.TypeCode
	 				 When WC7WorkersCompCov		    Is Not Null												   Then jr.TypeCode
	 				 When pa.WC7Jurisdiction	    Is Not Null And WC7JurisdictionCov			  Is Not Null  Then jrvc.TypeCode
	 				 When pa.WC7Jurisdiction	    Is Not Null And WC7Modifier				      Is Not Null  Then jrmod.TypeCode
	 				 When pa.WC7Jurisdiction	    Is Not Null And WC7WaiverOfSubro              Is Not Null  Then jrwos.TypeCode
	 				 When pa.WC7Jurisdiction	    Is Not Null												   Then jrvc.TypeCode
	 				 When (WC7SupplDiseaseExposure  Is Not Null or WC7SupplDiseaseExposureRateDev Is Not Null) Then jrdc.TypeCode
                End,LSju.TypeCode )    As LocationState
	, 'WC1'                            As ProductLkp
 From pcx_wc7transaction pt
 Join pc_policyperiod    pp  On pt.BranchID = pp.ID
 Join pcx_wc7cost        pa  On pt.WC7Cost  = pa.ID
	 --19thNov'16
 Left Join pcx_facreinsuranceagrdtl_ext fr On pa.AgreementDetail										     = fr.FixedID     And pa.BranchID = fr.BranchID
  And ((fr.EffectiveDate	  Is Null)	   OR (Coalesce(Cast(fr.EffectiveDate	  As Date), pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
  And ((fr.ExpirationDate	  Is Null)	   OR (Cast(fr.ExpirationDate			  As Date)					 > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
 Left Join pcx_wc7coveredemployee       ce On pa.WC7CoveredEmployee										     = ce.FixedID     And pa.BranchID = ce.BranchID --pa.WC7CoveredEmployee = ce.ID
  And ((ce.EffectiveDate	  Is Null)	   OR (Coalesce(Cast(ce.EffectiveDate	  As Date), pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
  And ((ce.ExpirationDate     Is Null)	   OR (Cast(ce.ExpirationDate			  As Date)					 > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
 Left Join pc_policylocation		polloc On ce.Location												     = polloc.FixedID And pa.BranchID = polloc.BranchID --ce.Location = polloc.ID
  And ((polloc.EffectiveDate  Is Null)	   OR (Coalesce(Cast(polloc.EffectiveDate As Date), pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
  And ((polloc.ExpirationDate Is Null)	   OR (Cast(polloc.ExpirationDate         As Date)					 > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
 Left Join pcx_wc7jurisdictioncov	  jcov On pa.BranchID													 = jcov.BranchID  And pa.WC7JurisdictionCov = jcov.FixedID
  And ((jcov.EffectiveDate	  Is Null)	   OR (Coalesce(Cast(jcov.EffectiveDate   As Date), pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
  And ((jcov.ExpirationDate   Is Null)	   OR (Cast(jcov.ExpirationDate			  As Date)					 > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
 Left Join pcx_wc7jurisdiction			vc On pa.BranchID													 = vc.BranchID	  And Coalesce(jcov.WC7Jurisdiction,pa.WC7Jurisdiction) = vc.FixedID
  And ((vc.EffectiveDate	  Is Null)	   OR (Coalesce(Cast(vc.EffectiveDate     As Date), pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
  And ((vc.ExpirationDate	  Is Null)	   OR (Cast(vc.ExpirationDate	          As Date)					 > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
 Left Join pcx_wc7modifier			  jmod On pa.BranchID													 = jmod.BranchID  And pa.WC7Modifier = jmod.FixedID
  And ((jmod.EffectiveDate	  Is Null)	   OR (Coalesce(Cast(jmod.EffectiveDate   As Date), pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
  And ((jmod.ExpirationDate   Is Null)	   OR (Cast(jmod.ExpirationDate			  As Date)					 > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
 Left Join pcx_wc7waiverofsubro		   wos On pa.BranchID												     = wos.BranchID   And pa.WC7WaiverOfSubro = wos.FixedID
  And ((wos.EffectiveDate	  Is Null)	   OR (Coalesce(Cast(wos.EffectiveDate    As Date), pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
  And ((wos.ExpirationDate	  Is Null)	   OR (Cast(wos.ExpirationDate			  As Date)				     > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
 Left Join pcx_wc7suppldiseaseexp	  supd On pa.BranchID												     = supd.BranchID  And Coalesce(pa.WC7SupplDiseaseExposure,pa.WC7SupplDiseaseExposureRateDev) = supd.FixedID
  And ((supd.EffectiveDate	  Is Null)	   OR (Coalesce(Cast(supd.EffectiveDate   As Date), pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
  And ((supd.ExpirationDate   Is Null)	   OR (Cast(supd.ExpirationDate			  As Date)				     > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
 Left Join pcx_wc7diseasecode		    dc On supd.DiseaseCodeID											 = dc.ID
 Left Join pc_uwcompany				    uc On pp.uwcompany												     = uc.ID
 Left Join pc_producercode		  prodcode On pp.ProducerCodeOfRecordID									     = prodcode.ID
 Left Join pc_group					   grp On prodcode.Agency_Ext											 = grp.ID
 Left Join pcx_groupagency_ext	     gaext On grp.GroupAgency_Ext											 = gaext.ID
 Left Join pc_policy					po On pp.PolicyID													 = po.ID
 Left Join pc_account					ac On po.AccountID													 = ac.ID
 Left Join pc_policyline			    pl On pa.WC7WorkersCompLine										     = pl.FixedID     And pa.BranchID = pl.BranchID
  And ((pl.EffectiveDate     Is Null)      OR (Coalesce(Cast(pl.EffectiveDate	  As Date), pp.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
  And ((pl.ExpirationDate    Is Null)      OR (Cast(pl.ExpirationDate			  As Date)					 > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))
 Left Join pc_job						 j On pp.JobID														 = j.ID
 Left Join pctl_job					   jtl On j.Subtype														 = jtl.ID
 Left Join pctl_policyperiodstatus     pps On pp.Status														 = pps.ID
 Left Join pctl_jurisdiction		  LSju On LSju.ID														 = pa.LocationState
 Left Join pctl_state				   stt On polloc.StateInternal											 = stt.ID
 Left Join pctl_jurisdiction		    jr On pa.Jurisdiction											     = jr.ID
 Left Join pctl_jurisdiction		  jrvc On vc.Jurisdiction												 = jrvc.ID
 Left Join pctl_jurisdiction		 jrmod On jmod.State													 = jrmod.ID
 Left Join pctl_jurisdiction	     jrwos On wos.Jurisdiction												 = jrwos.ID
 Left Join pctl_jurisdiction	      jrdc On dc.Jurisdiction											     = jrdc.ID
