select count(Publicid) from (
   Select Trx.PublicID                   As TransactionPublicID
        , Li.PublicID
		, Li.ID                          As GWRowNumber
        , Cast(Concat(Li.BeanVersion, Trx.BeanVersion) As Varchar(20)) As BeanVersion
        , 1                              As IsActive
        , Tacpow.TAccountOwner
        , Case Lds.TypeCode When
               Case When Taptype.[Name]  = 'ASSET'                 Then 'DEBIT'
                    When Taptype.[Name]  = 'REVENUE'               Then 'CREDIT'
                    When Taptype.[Name]  = 'LIABILITY'             Then 'CREDIT'
                    When Taptype.[Name]  = 'EXPENSE'               Then 'DEBIT'
                    When Taptype.[Name]  = 'EQUITY'                Then 'CREDIT'
               End          Then Li.Amount
          Else Li.Amount * -1       End                            As   SignedAmount
        , Li.PublicID                                              As   lkp_BillingTransactionID
        , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'Account'               Then IsNull(   Acc.PublicID,'-2')
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'Collateral'            Then           Col.lkp_BillingAccountID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'          Then            PP.lkp_BillingAccountID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'      Then       Polcomm.lkp_BillingAccountID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'      Then            Cc.lkp_BillingAccountID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'CollateralRequirement' Then          Colr.lkp_BillingAccountID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'       Then        Suspmt.lkp_BillingAccountID
          Else '-2'                  End                           As   lkp_BillingAccountID
        , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'Account'               Then IsNull(Billpl.PublicID,'-2')
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'Collateral'            Then           Col.lkp_BillingPlanID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'          Then            PP.lkp_BillingPlanID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'      Then       Polcomm.lkp_BillingPlanID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'      Then            CC.lkp_BillingPlanID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'CollateralRequirement' Then          Colr.lkp_BillingPlanID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'       Then        Suspmt.lkp_BillingPlanID
          Else '-2'                  End                           As   lkp_BillingPlanID
        , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'          Then Coalesce(  Uw.TypeCode,      PP.lkp_CompanyCode, '-2')
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'      Then Coalesce(  Uw.TypeCode, Polcomm.lkp_CompanyCode, '-2')
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'      Then Coalesce(  Uw.TypeCode,      CC.lkp_CompanyCode, '-2')
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'Account'               Then Coalesce(  Uw.TypeCode, Case When Ct.ContactType = 'Person' Then '03' When Ct.ContactType = 'Company' Then '21' End, '-2')
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'Collateral'            Then Coalesce(  Uw.TypeCode,     Col.lkp_CompanyCode, '-2')
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'CollateralRequirement' Then Coalesce(  Uw.TypeCode,    Colr.lkp_CompanyCode, '-2')
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'       Then Coalesce(  UW.TypeCode,  Suspmt.lkp_CompanyCode, '-2')
          Else  '-2'                 End                           As   lkp_CompanyCode
        , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'          Then            PP.lkp_PaymentPlanID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'      Then       Polcomm.lkp_PaymentPlanID
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'      Then            CC.lkp_PaymentPlanID
          Else '-2'                  End                           As   lkp_PaymentPlanID
        , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'          Then            PP.ProducerCode

               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'      Then       Polcomm.ProducerCode
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'      Then            CC.ProducerCode
          Else '-2'                  End                           As   lkp_ProducerID
        , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'          Then            PP.Agency
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ProducerCode'          Then            Pc.Agency
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'Producer'              Then IsNull(  Prod.AgencyCode_Ext, '-1')
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'      Then       Polcomm.Agency
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'      Then            Cc.Agency
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'       Then        Suspmt.Agency
          Else '-2'                  End                           As   lkp_AgencyID

		, Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'          Then            PP.ProducerCodeofService
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ProducerCode'          Then            Pc.ProducerCode
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'      Then       Polcomm.ProducerCodeofService
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'      Then            CC.ProducerCodeofService
			   When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'       Then        Suspmt.ProducerCodeofService
          Else '-2'                  End                           As   lkp_ProducerCodeofServiceID
        , Case When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyPeriod'          Then            PP.AgencyofService
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ProducerCode'          Then            Pc.Agency
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'Producer'              Then IsNull(  Prod.AgencyCode_Ext, '-1')
               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'PolicyCommission'      Then       Polcomm.AgencyofService

               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'SuspensePayment'       Then        Suspmt.AgencyofService

               When Tacpow.TAccountOwner = 'ChargeCommission'      Then            Cc.TermNumber

     Join bc_taccount                Tac On                  Tac.ID =  Li.TAccountID

     Join bc_TAccountPattern      Tacptr On               Tacptr.ID = Tac.TAccountPatternID

     Join bctl_taccount             Btac On                 Btac.ID = Tac.Subtype
Left Join bc_account                 Acc On Tac.TAccountContainerID = Acc.HiddenTAccountContainerID
Left Join bc_plan                 Billpl On               Billpl.ID = Acc.BillingPlanID
Left Join Collateral                 Col On Tac.TAccountContainerID = Col.HiddenTAccountContainerID
Left Join PolicyPeriod                PP On Tac.TAccountContainerID =  PP.HiddenTAccountContainerID
Left Join PolComm                Polcomm On Tac.TAccountContainerID = Polcomm.HiddenTAccountContainerID
Left Join bc_producer               Prod On Tac.TAccountContainerID = Prod.HiddenTAccountContainerID
Left Join ProducerCode                Pc On Tac.TAccountContainerID =  Pc.HiddenTAccountContainerID
Left Join SuspensePayment         Suspmt On Tac.TAccountContainerID = Suspmt.HiddenTAccountContainerID
Left Join ChargeComm                  Cc On Tac.TAccountContainerID =  CC.HiddenTAccountContainerID
Left Join CollateralReq             Colr On Tac.TAccountContainerID = Colr.HiddenTAccountContainerID
Left Join bc_revtrans        TxnReversal On Trx.ID                  = TxnReversal.OwnerID
Left Join bc_transfertxcontext TxnTrnsfr On TxnTrnsfr.TransactionID = Coalesce(TxnReversal.ForeignEntityID, Trx.ID)
Left Join bc_fundstransfer   FundsTrnsfr On          FundsTrnsfr.ID = TxnTrnsfr.FundsTransferID
Left Join bctl_transferreason     Trfrsn On               Trfrsn.ID = FundsTrnsfr.Reason
Left Join bctl_reversalreason      Rvrsn On                Rvrsn.ID = Trx.ReversalReason
Left Join bctl_taccounttype      Taptype On              Taptype.ID = Tacptr.TAccountType

    Where 1 = 1
      -- And ( Li.UpdateTime >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementalDays , Cast(GetDate() As Date))

       --Or  Coalesce(pp.UpdateTime, Col.UpdateTime, Polcomm.UpdateTime, Prod.UpdateTime, Pc.UpdateTime, Suspmt.UpdateTime, CC.UpdateTime, Colr.UpdateTime) >= DateAdd(D, @IncrementalDays , Cast(GetDate() As Date))

, LSju.TypeCode As LocationState

  And ((fr.ExpirationDate Is Null)  OR (Cast(fr.ExpirationDate As Date)  > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, pp.PeriodStart)))

  And ((expsr.ExpirationDate  Is Null)  OR (Cast(expsr.ExpirationDate As Date) > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, PeriodStart)))

  And ((ptcov.ExpirationDate  Is Null)  OR (Cast(ptcov.ExpirationDate As Date)	 > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, PeriodStart)))

  And ((polloc.ExpirationDate Is Null)  OR (Cast(polloc.ExpirationDate  As Date)	 > Coalesce(pt.EffDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_policy  po ON pp.PolicyID = po.ID
  Left Join pc_account  ac ON po.AccountID = ac.ID
  Left Join pctl_jurisdiction  ju ON ju.ID = pa.GLState
  Left Join pcx_gl7statrecord_gle st ON st.ID  = pa.StatRecord
  Left Join pc_job j ON pp.JobID = j.ID
  Left Join pctl_job jtl ON j.Subtype = jtl.ID
  Left Join pctl_policyperiodstatus   pps ON pp.Status = pps.ID
  Left Join pctl_jurisdiction  LSju ON LSju.ID = pa.LocationState
 Where 1 = 1

   And (pp.ModelDate Is Not Null Or (jtl.Name = 'Audit' And pps.Name = 'Completed'))

  Left Join pc_policylocation			  Polloc   On Coalesce(Bsci.IMLocation, L.Location)							 = polloc.FixedID	      And Pa.BranchID         = polloc.BranchID
		And ((Polloc.EffectiveDate		  Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(Polloc.EffectiveDate As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Polloc.ExpirationDate		  Is Null) Or (Cast(Polloc.ExpirationDate         As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_uwcompany			      Uc       On PP.uwcompany													 = Uc.ID
  Left Join pc_producercode				  ProdCode On PP.ProducerCodeOfRecordID										 = ProdCode.ID
  Left Join pc_group					  Grp      On ProdCode.Agency_Ext											 = Grp.ID
  Left Join pcx_groupagency_ext			  Gaext    On Grp.GroupAgency_Ext										     = GaExt.ID
  Left Join pc_policy					  Po       On PP.PolicyID													 = Po.ID
  Left Join pc_policyline				  Pl       On Pl.BranchID												     = Pa.BranchID			  And Pa.InlandMarineLine = Pl.FixedID
	    And ((Pl.EffectiveDate			  Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(Pl.EffectiveDate     As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Pl.ExpirationDate			  Is Null) Or (Cast(Pl.ExpirationDate			  As Date)					 > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_account					  Ac       On Po.AccountID													 = Ac.ID
  Left Join pc_EffectiveDatedfields       Ef       On PP.ID															 = Ef.BranchID            And Ef.PrimaryLocation  = Pl.FixedID
		And ((Ef.EffectiveDate			  Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Ef.EffectiveDate				  , PP.PeriodStart)	<= Coalesce(Pl.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart)))
		And ((Ef.ExpirationDate			  Is Null) Or (Ef.ExpirationDate										     > Coalesce(Pl.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_job						  J		   On PP.JobID													     = J.ID
  Left Join pctl_job					  Jtl	   On J.Subtype														 = JtL.ID
  Left Join pctl_policyperiodstatus		  PPs	   On PP.Status														 = PPs.ID
       Join pctl_imcost					  CCst	   On Pa.Subtype												     = CCst.ID
  Left Join pc_job						  Jh	   On Jh.JobNumber													 = (Case When H.CommentText  Is Not Null Then Substring(CommentText, 11,10) Else Null End)
  Left Join pc_policyperiod				  Ph	   On Jh.ID															 = Ph.JobID		          And Ph.ModelDate Is Not Null
  Where 1 = 1
  --  And T.UpDateTime >= Dateadd(D, ?, GetDate())
) as main;

select COUNT(Publicid) from (Select T.ID																																	 As GWRowNumber
     , T.PublicID
	 , Coalesce(Ph.ID						    , PP.ID																 )						 As BranchID
     , Coalesce(Ph.PublicID			            , PP.PublicID										   , '-2'        )						 As PolicyNumberLkp
	 , Pa.subtype
	 , IsNull(Uc.PublicID																			   , '-2'		 )						 As CompanyLkp
	 , IsNull(ProdCode.PublicID																		   , '-2'		 )						 As ProducerLkp
	 , IsNull(GaExt.PublicID																		   , '-2'	     )						 As AgencyLkp
	 , IsNull(Ac.PublicID																			   ,  '2'		 )						 As AccountLkp
	 , Case When Bsci.IMLocation Is Null And L.location Is Null Then '-2' Else IsNull(polloc.PublicID  , '-1'	     ) End					 As RiskLocationLkp
	 , IsNull(B.PublicID																			   , '-2'	     )						 As BuildingLkp
	 , IsNull(Pl.PublicID																			   , '-2'		 )						 As LOBLkp
	 , IsNull(Pa.PublicID																			   , '-2'		 )						 As CoverageLkp
	 , Cast(IsNull(Pa.EffectiveDate			    , PP.PeriodStart           ) As DateTime)													 As CoverageEffectiveDate
     , IsNull(Cast(Convert(Varchar			    , PP.PeriodStart	  , 101) As DateTime)			   , '12/31/9999')						 As PolicyEffectiveDateLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert(Varchar			    , T.EFFectiveDate	  , 101) As DateTime)			   , '12/31/9999')						 As EffectiveDateLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert(Varchar			    , T.ExpirationDate	  , 101) As DateTime)			   , '12/31/9999')					     As ExpirationDateLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert(Varchar			    , T.DateWritten		  , 101) As DateTime)			   , '12/31/9999')						 As WrittEndateLkp
	 , IsNull(Cast(Convert(Varchar			    , T.DatePosted        , 101) As DateTime)			   , '12/31/9999')						 As PostedDateLkp
	 , Case When T.DatePosted Is Not Null
	        Then Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar , T.DatePosted		  , 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, T.EffectiveDate     , 101) As DateTime)
                      Then Cast(Convert(Varchar , T.DatePosted		  , 101) As DateTime)
                 Else      Cast(Convert(Varchar , T.EffectiveDate	  , 101) As DateTime)   End
       Else '12/31/9999' End																												 As RecognizedDate
     , Case When Cast(Convert(Varchar		    , J.CloseDate         , 101) As DateTime) > Cast(Convert(Varchar, PP.EditEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)
            Then Cast(Convert(Varchar		    , J.CloseDate         , 101) As DateTime)
       Else      Cast(Convert(Varchar		    , PP.EditEffectiveDate, 101) As DateTime)   End												 As DWPRecognizedDate
	 , 'IM1'																																 As ProductLkp
	 , T.CededPremium
	 , T.SpoilageLimit_Ext
	 , T.SpoilageRate_Ext
	 , T.CommissionRate
	 , T.CededRiskAmount
	 , T.CedingRate
	 , T.CalcTimestamp
	 , T.DateWritten
	 , T.DatePosted
	 , Rp.PublicID																															 As ProgramPublicID
	 , Ra.PublicID																														     As AgreementPublicID
  From pc_imcededpremiumtransaction		  T
  Left Join pc_imcededpremiumhistory	  H        On T.IMCededPremiumHistory										 = H.ID
  Left Join pc_imcededpremium			  E        On T.IMCededPremium												 = E.ID
  Left Join pc_RIProgram				  Rp       On T.Program														 = Rp.ID
  Left Join Pc_ReinsuranceAgreement		  Ra       On T.Agreement													 = Ra.ID
       Join pc_imcost					  Pa       On E.IMCost														 = Pa.ID
	   Join pc_policyperiod               PP       On Pa.BranchID													 = PP.ID
--IMBasePartExclCost_Ext--
  Left Join pcx_imbasepartexclusion_ext   Bpe      On Pa.partexclusion												 = Bpe.FixedID            And Pa.BranchID		  = Bpe.BranchID
        And ((Bpe.EffectiveDate           Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(Bpe.EffectiveDate    As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
        And ((Bpe.ExpirationDate          Is Null) Or (Cast(Bpe.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
--IMBasePartCondCost_Ext--
  Left Join pcx_imbasepartcondition_ex    Bpc      On Pa.partcondition												 = Bpc.FixedID            And Pa.BranchID		  = Bpc.BranchID
		And ((Bpc.EffectiveDate           Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(Bpc.EffectiveDate    As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Bpc.ExpirationDate          Is Null) Or (Cast(Bpc.ExpirationDate            As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
-- IMBaseSchedCovItemCovCost_Ext --
  Left Join pcx_imbaseschedcovitemcov_ext Bscic    On Pa.itemcoverage											     = Bscic.FixedID		  And Pa.BranchID		  = Bscic.BranchID
		And ((Bscic.EffectiveDate		  Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(Bscic.EffectiveDate  As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Bscic.ExpirationDate		  Is Null) Or (Cast(Bscic.ExpirationDate          As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
--IMBasePartCovCombCost_Ext
  Left Join pcx_imbaseschedcovitmcomb_ext Bpcb     On Pa.itmcomb												     = BpcB.FixedID           And Pa.BranchID	      = BpcB.BranchID
		And ((Bpcb.EffectiveDate          Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(Bpcb.EffectiveDate   As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Bpcb.ExpirationDate         Is Null) Or (Cast(Bpcb.ExpirationDate           As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
--IMBasePartCovCost_Ext --
  Left Join pcx_imbasepartcoverage_ext    Bpcv     On Pa.partcoverage												 = Bpcv.FixedID           And Pa.BranchID		  = Bpcv.BranchID
		And ((Bpcv.EffectiveDate          Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(Bpcv.EffectiveDate   As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
	    And (( Bpcv.ExpirationDate        Is Null) Or (Cast(Bpcv.ExpirationDate           As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
--Building&Location---
  Left Join pcx_imbaseschedcovitem_ext	  Bsci     On Bscic.item													 = Bsci.FixedID			  And Pa.BranchID		  = Bsci.BranchID
		And ((Bsci.EffectiveDate		  Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(Bsci.EffectiveDate   As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Bsci.ExpirationDate		  Is Null) Or (Cast(Bsci.ExpirationDate           As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_IMBuilding				  B        On Bsci .IMBuilding												 = B.FixedID			  And Pa.BranchID		  = B.BranchID
		And ((B.EffectiveDate			  Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(B.EffectiveDate	  As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((B.ExpirationDate			  Is Null) Or (Cast(B.ExpirationDate			  As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_IMLocation				  L        On B.IMLocation													 = L.FixedID			  And Pa.BranchID         = L.BranchID
	    And ((L.EffectiveDate			  Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(L.EffectiveDate      As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((L.ExpirationDate			  Is Null) Or (Cast(L.ExpirationDate              As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_policylocation			  Polloc   On Coalesce(Bsci.IMLocation, L.Location)							 = polloc.FixedID	      And Pa.BranchID         = polloc.BranchID
		And ((Polloc.EffectiveDate		  Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(Polloc.EffectiveDate As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Polloc.ExpirationDate		  Is Null) Or (Cast(Polloc.ExpirationDate         As Date)                   > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_uwcompany			      Uc       On PP.uwcompany													 = Uc.ID
  Left Join pc_producercode				  ProdCode On PP.ProducerCodeOfRecordID										 = ProdCode.ID
  Left Join pc_group					  Grp      On ProdCode.Agency_Ext											 = Grp.ID
  Left Join pcx_groupagency_ext			  Gaext    On Grp.GroupAgency_Ext										     = GaExt.ID
  Left Join pc_policy					  Po       On PP.PolicyID													 = Po.ID
  Left Join pc_policyline				  Pl       On Pl.BranchID												     = Pa.BranchID			  And Pa.InlandMarineLine = Pl.FixedID
	    And ((Pl.EffectiveDate			  Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Cast(Pl.EffectiveDate     As Date), PP.PeriodStart) <= Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
		And ((Pl.ExpirationDate			  Is Null) Or (Cast(Pl.ExpirationDate			  As Date)					 > Coalesce(Pa.EffectiveDate, PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_account					  Ac       On Po.AccountID													 = Ac.ID
  Left Join pc_EffectiveDatedfields       Ef       On PP.ID															 = Ef.BranchID            And Ef.PrimaryLocation  = Pl.FixedID
		And ((Ef.EffectiveDate			  Is Null) Or (Coalesce(Ef.EffectiveDate				  , PP.PeriodStart)	<= Coalesce(Pl.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart)))
		And ((Ef.ExpirationDate			  Is Null) Or (Ef.ExpirationDate										     > Coalesce(Pl.EffectiveDate, PP.PeriodStart)))
  Left Join pc_job						  J		   On PP.JobID													     = J.ID
  Left Join pctl_job					  Jtl	   On J.Subtype														 = JtL.ID
  Left Join pctl_policyperiodstatus		  PPs	   On PP.Status														 = PPs.ID
       Join pctl_imcost					  CCst	   On Pa.Subtype												     = CCst.ID
  Left Join pc_job						  Jh	   On Jh.JobNumber													 = (Case When H.CommentText  Is Not Null Then Substring(CommentText, 11,10) Else Null End)
  Left Join pc_policyperiod				  Ph	   On Jh.ID															 = Ph.JobID		          And Ph.ModelDate Is Not Null
  Where 1 = 1
  --  And T.UpDateTime >= Dateadd(D, ?, GetDate())
) as main;
